Matrigluco does not diagnose medical conditions. Assessment results, health tracking telemetry, and AI Assistant explanations are educational tools designed to support clinical awareness. They must never replace professional evaluation, diagnosis, or treatment by a qualified obstetrician or healthcare professional.

The AI Assistant provides conversational maternal health information based on curated guidelines. It does not prescribe medication, make clinical determinations, or possess medical licensing. In an emergency, contact your hospital immediately.
Complete overview of data storage and transmission

UI theme preferences, onboarding completion markers, selected measurement units (e.g. mg/dL), offline Room database cache, and encrypted session tokens stored in the Android KeyStore stay on this device.

When you are online, authenticated actions send profile parameters, glucose and vitals measurements, risk assessment inputs, medical report uploads, and chat messages to your secure Matrigluco server deployment.
Blood glucose logs, blood pressure, fetal kick counts, weight, and meal context are stored in your authenticated patient record to render your longitudinal Care Chronicle.
Assessment submissions (age, pregnancies, glucose, blood pressure, skin thickness, insulin, BMI, and pedigree function) are evaluated on the backend by the risk model to compute probability bands.

Uploaded laboratory PDFs and images are stored in a private authenticated evidence vault. Access is restricted to your authenticated user account via Bearer token verification. No public URLs are generated.

Chat messages are processed by the backend AI runtime. Health context is only included when you explicitly enable the AI Context preference. Your conversational data is never used to train third-party public models.
Care reminders and appointment alerts are delivered locally or via authenticated push. Sensitive clinical values are omitted from standard lock-screen notifications.
Matrigluco maintains a local Room SQLite cache so you can review recent logs offline. Local cached data is cleared upon sign-out or through Data Controls.

Data retention is governed by the configured backend deployment policy. Deleting individual readings or reports in the app sends an authenticated DELETE request to remove them from your active record.
Conditions governing the use of the Matrigluco workspace
Matrigluco is an educational and research-driven maternal health companion designed to assist expectant mothers with gestational health tracking, risk awareness, and document organization.

This workspace is intended for expectant mothers and authorized caregivers seeking organized health telemetry. You must be at least 18 years of age or possess legal guardian consent to maintain an account.
You are responsible for safeguarding your login credentials. If you suspect unauthorized access, update your password immediately in Account Settings.
You retain ownership of any medical documents and records you upload. You agree not to upload harmful, corrupted, or unlawful material.
Matrigluco features depend on network connectivity and backend service availability. Offline caching is provided as a convenience, but live risk calculation and AI discussions require online access.
Architecture, inference runtimes, and algorithmic boundaries
Evaluates 8 clinical variables (Age, Pregnancies, Glucose, Blood Pressure, Skin Thickness, Insulin, BMI, Pedigree Function) to produce gestational diabetes probability estimates.

Runs via the backend AI engine utilizing curated maternal health guidance. The Android client communicates via authenticated REST endpoints and does not execute heavy neural network weights on device.
How your laboratory documents are protected and parsed
You choose a file using the Android System Document Picker. The app never scans your private storage.
The file is transferred directly over TLS with your Bearer token to private backend storage.
Backend optical recognition extracts glucose curves, HbA1c, and lab parameters respecting patient tenant isolation.
Extracted parameters are flagged for your review before becoming part of your official tracking timeline.
